## Problem and change
Describe the problem and resulting behaviour.

## Validation
List automated checks and actual device/Store checks. Identify platforms not exercised.

## Checklist
- [ ] Public API or behaviour changes are documented.
- [ ] Dependency changes include reviewed lock-file updates.
- [ ] No credentials, purchase evidence, signing material or paid assets are included.
- [ ] Pending, cancelled and unverified purchases never grant new access.
